title: Responsive small-viewport and flex-friendly layout across main panels, inspectors, and modals

sections.what: Audit and fix fixed-width/non-wrapping layouts across the main workspace, side panels, inspectors, and modals so VirtualWorld remains usable on small devices, high-DPI zoom viewports (e.g. 4K at 250% scaling), and narrow browser windows without clipped controls, overlapping sidebars, or horizontal overflow. Existing @media breakpoints (1240px, 1200px, 1000px, 899px, 880px, 640px) in static/css/style.css should be extended rather than duplicated, focusing on remaining fixed-width modals, inspectors, and WorldPainter surfaces.
sections.why: Observed live in the browser UI: several views and toolbars are not small-device or flex-friendly when the viewport is narrow or zoomed in, causing side panels, toolbars, and modal controls to crowd or clip instead of wrapping, collapsing, or flexing gracefully.
sections.how:
1. Inspect `templates/index.html` and `static/css/style.css` (plus modal/inspector styles in `static/js/inspector/`, `static/js/worldpainter/`, `static/js/ui/`, and `static/js/shared/diff-modal.ts`) at narrow/zoomed viewports (e.g. 1280x720, 1024x768, 768x900).
2. Replace rigid pixel widths/heights and non-wrapping flex rows with fluid `clamp()`, `min()`, `max()`, `flex-wrap: wrap`, `min-width: 0`, and responsive media/container breakpoints.
3. Ensure left/right sidebars, top toolbar, inspectors, and modals either collapse/toggle cleanly or stack/scroll without horizontal page overflow or inaccessible action buttons.
4. Verify live in the browser at multiple viewport sizes and zooms with screenshots.
sections.verify: Verify live in browser at desktop (1440x900), zoomed/compact (1280x720), and small/narrow (768x900) viewports with zero horizontal overflow, zero clipped primary controls, and 0 console errors.

acceptance.text: Top toolbar, left/right sidebars, and main canvas/stream remain usable with zero clipped primary controls at compact/zoomed (1280x720) and narrow (768x900) viewports.
Inspectors, Scenario Manager, Settings, Human Turn Composer, and WorldPainter adapt via fluid CSS (`clamp()`, `min()`, `flex-wrap`, `min-width: 0`) instead of overflowing horizontally.
Verified visually via screenshots at both wide and narrow/zoomed viewports.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Main app shell, toolbars, side panels, inspectors, and modals on http://localhost:4444/ at compact/zoomed and narrow viewports.

Current availability: Observed during live browser testing on 2026-11-18 that views are not small-device/flex-friendly when zoomed in.

Manual verification steps:
1. Resize viewport to 1280x720 and 768x900 (or zoom in).
2. Open toolbar dropdowns, inspectors, Scenario Manager, Turn Composer, and WorldPainter.
   - expected: Controls wrap or scroll cleanly inside viewport bounds with no clipped buttons or horizontal overflow.
